# iGaming SEO Consulting — Nestor Vazquez

> SEO consulting for iGaming operators, affiliate networks and media groups.
> 15+ years of experience in iGaming and affiliate SEO in highly competitive markets across USA, Europe and LATAM.

## Services

- iGaming Affiliate SEO — casino, sports betting and poker affiliate portfolios
- Technical SEO audits — crawlability, indexation, architecture, Core Web Vitals, migrations, domain consolidation
- PBN and tiered linkbuilding — footprint management, hosting separation, anchor and link-velocity risk controls
- Parasite SEO and expired domains — controlled, documented experiments; winners get scaled
- CTR and user-signal optimisation — organic CTR, SERP presentation, behavioural signals
- SEO training and recovery — team training (SEO, content, dev), negative SEO detection and recovery, SEO automation (Python, Apps Script, AI)
